title: Diagnostic node (flat form)
description: One entry of the flattened tree that `server/tools/check_content.py --emit-nodes` writes. The tree itself stays nested (curriculum/grade6-up.json); this is the shape a report or an external tool consumes. Aggregate nodes are the `unit` rows and carry node_type=aggregate with no questions; only diagnostic nodes can be judged weak.

node_id.description: Stable business key. Diagnostic nodes end in -dNN, aggregate (chapter) nodes in -uNN.

parent_id.description: For a diagnostic node, the chapter's -uNN code. Null on aggregates.

micro_nodes.description: The textbook's own sub-points this node covers. At least one: a node nobody can name a sub-point for is not diagnosable.
